title: Enhancement: "show vrf <vrfname>" for unconfigured VRFs should give an error
author: spandan-nexthop
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Low

### Description of the enhancement

This is a copy of https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-utilities/issues/4378, created for visibility.

The current behaviour is confusing because the exit code is misleading. Querying unconfigured VRFs should fail with a failure exit code.

cc: @donggyu-nexthop

### Current Behavior

Currently, `show vrf <vrfname>`, when supplied with the name of an unconfigured VRF, returns with a non-failure exit code and prints an empty VRF table to stdout.

### Proposed Behavior

An explicit message informing the user that <vrfname> is not configured - `VRF {vrf_name} is not configured.`

linkedPullRequests.title: Handle edge case where user-supplied VRF is not configured
linkedPullRequests.author: donggyu-nexthop
linkedPullRequests.body:

    your changes.

    Please provide the following information:
-->

#### What I did

Closes #4378 and fixes: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/26488

The command `show vrf <vrfname>`, when supplied a VRF that isn't configured, would return an empty table to stdout along with a non-failure exit code.

#### How I did it

`show/main.py` was modified to explicltly handle the edge case where the user invokes `show vrf <unconfigured vrf>`, which now returns an error message

#### How to verify it

Run `show vrf <vrfname>`, where `<vrfname>` is the name of an unconfigured VRF.

The new unit test at tests/vrf_test.py also verifies the new behavior.

#### Previous command output (if the output of a command-line utility has changed)

```
$ show vrf Vrf-null
VRF        Interfaces
-------    ------------
```

#### New command output (if the output of a command-line utility has changed)
```
$ show vrf Vrf-null
Usage: show vrf [OPTIONS] [VRF_NAME]
Try 'show vrf -h' for help.

Error: VRF Vrf-null is not configured.
```
